schema.paper_arms:
CREATE TABLE paper_arms(
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 arm TEXT NOT NULL,
 attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 session_id TEXT,
 prompt_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 p_up REAL, expected_return_bps REAL, uncertainty REAL,
 action TEXT, response_sha256 TEXT,
 completed_ms INTEGER,
 PRIMARY KEY(event_id, arm))
schema.paper_entries:
CREATE TABLE paper_entries(
 event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 price REAL NOT NULL,
 observed_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
 source TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.paper_outcomes:
CREATE TABLE paper_outcomes(
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 horizon_h INTEGER NOT NULL,
 exit_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
 price REAL NOT NULL,
 settled_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
 observed_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, due_ms INTEGER, drift_ms INTEGER, method TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(event_id, horizon_h))
schema.paper_records:
CREATE TABLE paper_records(
 event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 cohort TEXT NOT NULL,
 source TEXT NOT NULL,
 published_ms INTEGER,
 observed_ms INTEGER,
 cutoff_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
 reserved_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
 completed_ms INTEGER,
 provider_id TEXT,
 model_id TEXT,
 seal_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 synthetic INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 state TEXT NOT NULL)
